notes: The manufacturer 09C1 map matches twelve complete cloud read cycles; two Oct 1 owner support snapshots show connected local 09C1 polling with 22 fresh readings and no raw timeouts.
Detection names the protocol family, not an exact retail model. No unique inverter serial is available.
Separate owner PV1/PV2 captures qualify optional protocol-numbered voltage/current reads. The non-simultaneous snapshots are not a combined sample; this unit's physical port labels appear crossed.

known_limitations: Read-only even in Full Control; no qualified write command map.
No inferred output/PV/battery power or SOC. PV energy and ambiguous status fields remain raw support evidence.
PV? is a legacy single-command reading, not a verified total. Optional PV1/PV2 support is qualified empirically per runtime, without a family capability flag or universal physical-port mapping.
Cloud-server address and connection recovery are separate from inverter-map support.
knowledge_summary: Q1/QF/PV?/F provide electrical readings, load, temperature, operating state and ratings. Bounded optional PV1/PV2 reads add separate protocol-numbered voltage/current channels after both reply shapes qualify; they do not replace PV? or supply a total. Plain ASCII+CR over FC4 is separate from the addressed Short-ASCII dialect.
